notes:
Titles and DOIs verified against retrieved paper headings. Replication source is author-uploaded manuscript full-text HTML on ResearchGate; manuscript pagination differs from published locator. Original is published-paper full-text HTML reproduction on Scribd. Figure 1 path a is located but its coefficient/significance is not recovered by the accessible text parse; left null. No substitution of the Table 1 t-test, d = .49, or indirect path estimates for the requested Figure 1 path. Original n=153 established from reported recruitment and model-specific exclusion, not the bivariate N=154. Replication paper labels Nelson et al. (2013) as its original comparator; assigned original here is Bonam et al. Study 1. The quoted verdict concerns the same historical-knowledge racial-category effect.
Completion source review (n_r): Final sample explicitly consists of mutually exclusive White and Black groups used in the study analyses. No participants excluded from data analyses; final groups are the 108 White and 117 Black students obtained in Study 2.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Target identified by study, racial-category predictor and historical-knowledge outcome. Retained printed β coefficient; no conversion, and standardization is not explicitly defined in the excerpt.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Target identified by study, racial-category predictor and historical-knowledge outcome. Exact equality p value printed alongside the target β in the same regression.
